sidebar.title: BOOK OF MEMORY OF THE LEMKO REGION 1944–1946
sidebar.text: The “Book of Memory of the Lemko Region 1944–1946” contains the lists of Ukrainian Lemkos forcibly evicted in 1944–1946 by the communist regimes of Poland and the USSR. Based on archival documents, the book preserves the memory of the Lemko tragedy and serves as a reference for the descendants of the deportees. Author: Yaroslava Halyk.

about.title: About the project
about.text1: The “Book of Memory of the Lemko Region 1944–1946” is a martyrology of the Ukrainian Lemkos who fell victim to the criminal resettlement campaign carried out by the communist regimes of Poland and the USSR in 1944–1946. As a result, hundreds of thousands of Lemkos were forcibly evicted from their ancestral ethnic lands, then under Polish rule, to the Ukrainian SSR. The lists of deported families and persons are arranged by the settlements of the Lemko Region and based on archival documents.
about.text2: This book is documentary evidence of the Lemko tragedy of the mid-20th century and a warning against similar crimes. It is an important reference for deported Lemkos and their descendants, helping them find their families. It will also be a useful resource for local historians, researchers, scholars and historians.
about.text3: Idea, project lead and compiler: Yaroslava Halyk. Photocopies of archival documents: Yaroslava Halyk, Oleh Radziievskyi (in vol. 1 also Ivan Chelak). Technical editing: Andrii Khomyn. Technical support: Denys Halyk. Typesetting: Yaroslava Halyk, Andrii Khomyn (in vol. 1 also Valeriia Halyk, Oleksii Halyk, Andrii Shafran, Fr. Taras Hrem). The book was published with the financial support of the Lemko Research Foundation in the USA.
